name: A11 Health Monitor
description: Vérifie la santé d'A11 après chaque tâche spec complétée

then.command: powershell -Command "try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/health' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host \"A11: $($r.status)\" } catch { Write-Host \"A11: DOWN - $($_.Exception.Message)\" }"
